text:
OneXray 

 
 An open-source Xray-core client for phones, tablets and desktops.
 

 
 English · 简体中文 · Русский 
 

 Download from the official stores 

 
  
  
 
 

 
 Documentation · Installation · System requirements 
 

 
 
 
 

 Bring your own servers or subscription. OneXray does not provide VPN access or proxy servers.

 

 Features

- iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android, Windows and Linux, with light/dark themes and five interface languages.
- Share links, Xray JSON, subscriptions, manual groups and server testing.
- Smart and Custom Routing, Raw JSON and complete provider configurations, including Remnawave.
- No accounts, advertising, analytics or tracking. Privacy policy.

 Downloads

Use the official store buttons above. See the system requirements and installation guide for supported devices, standalone packages and updates.

- Linux: DEB and ZIP · Fedora ZIP · Arch Linux ZIP.
- OneXraySE for macOS: Homebrew · System Extension setup.
- APK, IPA and Windows installers: Installation guide · All releases.

 Documentation and support

First connection · Import servers · Routing · Configure with AI · All documentation

Report a bug or request a feature with your App/Core versions and reproduction steps; remove credentials from configurations and logs. Join the Telegram community.

Contributions are welcome: development setup · build guide · App contracts.

 License

GPL-3.0, with the VPN Provider Exception. The exception permits dedicated closed-source clients only for the provider's own VPN service, without general-purpose third-party configuration or subscription support, and requires visible in-app OneXray attribution and a project link. See the full exception for all conditions and third-party obligations.

Business inquiries: yuan@yuandev.net.
